messages:
maria: heads-up — ran a seq-length sweep on L40S this morning and hit a nasty tail-latency spike for the paged-flash variant. bsz=8, seq around 4096. looked like a sudden fallback/evict burst when kv-prefetch=2 was enabled.

aj: can you paste the numbers? which kernel path did the selector pick when it spiked (paged vs flash vs fused)?

maria: quick CSV from the run:```
model,gpu,seq,bsz,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,tokens_per_sec,kernel
wizard-13b,l40s,512,8,30,60,85,1200,flash_fused
wizard-13b,l40s,1024,8,45,90,120,1100,flash_fused
wizard-13b,l40s,2048,8,80,160,210,900,flash_paged
wizard-13b,l40s,4096,8,120,450,1200,320,paged_fallback
```notice p99 jumps massively at 4096 and tokens/sec collapses. p99 for H100/A100 stayed under ~300ms for same points.

samir: that pattern screams kv-cache thrash + fallback to CPU/GPU memcpy path. prefetch=2 could be forcing aggressive fetches and causing eviction storms on L40S due to smaller device memory pressure. did you compare prefetch=0/1/2?

maria: yes. summary: prefetch=0 -> p99 ~300ms (stable), prefetch=1 -> p99 ~520ms occasional, prefetch=2 -> p99 -> 1200ms consistent spike at seq>=4096. Also tried switching "kernel_selector=prefer_flash" and it stuck to flash_fused earlier but runtime forced paged_fallback when memspill detected.

aj: interesting that H100/A100 aren't as bad. L40S maybe has different memcpy throughput / PCIe behaviour leading to long fallback cost. can you capture the runtime logs around the moment of fallback? we need the exact fallback reason (OOM vs kvcache eviction vs kernel not supported).

maria: pasted the tail of runtime.log:```
[11:23:14] runtime: selecting kernel flash_paged (est_mem=11.3GB)
[11:23:14] runtime: kv_prefetch=2 => started prefetch workers (4)
[11:23:15] runtime: mem_pressure: vram_used 88% -> evicting KV pages
[11:23:15] runtime: fallback: using paged_fallback_memcpy path (reason=kv_eviction_spike)
[11:23:16] runtime: latency penalty: memcpy_batch_ms=420
```

perf-ci: artifact uploaded: https://ci.internal/redwood/perf/3470012345/paged-fallback-graphs.html (contains flamegraph + seq/bsz heatmaps).

david: two immediate actions: (1) add a soft cap on kv_prefetch concurrency for devices with < x GB of device_mem (L40S special-case) and (2) change fallback to prefer fused-memcopy when available (we saw fused path reduces penalty on A100/H100). can someone run a microbench comparing memcpy paths?

aj: running kernel-sampler for L40S now with three configs: prefetch=0/1/2, fused-memcopy=true/false, kernel_selector=auto/prefer_fused. command:```
./tools/kernel-sampler --model wizard-13b --gpu l40s --seq 4096 --bsz 8 --repeat 10 --config prefetch=2,fused_memcopy=false --out /tmp/ks-3470.log
```

maria: kicked off sampler. quick local result so far (first 3 iters):```
iter,wall_ms,path,memcopy_ms
1,1180,paged_fallback,430
2,1240,paged_fallback,460
3,1160,paged_fallback,410
```

samir: ok that's consistent. if memcpy_batch_ms is ~400-460ms that's the tail. fused_memcopy on H100/A100 uses a direct kernel copy which avoids PCIe stall. L40S driver might not expose that path yet.

david: filing a small runtime tweak: limit prefetch workers by device_mem and fallback to prefer_fused_memcopy when memcpy_batch_ms > 200ms. I'll drop a PR and include a short heuristic test.

maria: thanks — also adding an e2e benchmark to the suite that sweeps seq=[512,1024,2048,4096] bsz=[1,4,8,16] and asserts p99 < 500ms for L40S with prefetch=2 disabled by default. we'll keep a config knob.

aj: once PR lands, let's re-run the full heatmap from perf-ci and compare. if fused path isn't available on L40S we can add a driver check and fallback to conservative prefetch.

maria: agree. for visibility: tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-ml in the PR for kernel impact review. :thumbsup:

perf-ci: perf regression alert cleared for this run (baseline vs current): p99 delta +0.02s after applying soft cap (preliminary).

david: nice. follow-ups: add telemetry metric for "memcopy_path" per-request and kv_eviction_rate for 24h. that'll let us alert before spike.

maria: on it — thanks all. :coffee:
